g.text: The device ID and the MIDI channel are different
things and are set in different places on the unit.
A request with the wrong device ID is answered with
silence, which looks exactly like a wrong cable.
The last byte of a version reply may be a checksum;
whether unnumbered replies carry one is not
no catalog -- numbers only. Build one with tools/extract_catalog.py, or press r to read from the unit.
↑↓ move · tab pane · ⏎ select on the unit · r read names · / search · [ ] channel · c set channel · f favourite
